贝叶斯估计中的计算-效用-隐私权衡Computation-Utility-Privacy Tradeoffs in Bayesian Estimation

Sitan Chen
Harvard Email: sitan@seas.harvard.edu, supported in part by NSF CAREER award CCF-2441635    Jingqiu Ding
ETH Zurich Email: jingqiu.ding@inf.ethz.ch, supported by European Research Council (ERC) under the European Union’s Horizon 2020 research and innovation programme (grant agreement No 815464)    Mahbod Majid
MIT Email: mahbod@mit.edu    Walter McKelvie
Harvard Email: wmckelvie@fas.harvard.edu, supported in part by NSF GRFP award 2140743 and CAREER award CCF-2441635
(2026 年 3 月 18 日March 18, 2026)
摘要Abstract

贝叶斯方法是现代数据科学的核心，为数据受限环境中的估计以及不确定性的原则量化和传播提供了强大的支架。然而，在部署这些方法的许多现实用例中，自然需要保护其数据受到审查的个人的隐私。虽然许多作品试图解决这个问题Bayesian methods lie at the heart of modern data science and provide a powerful scaffolding for estimation in data-constrained settings and principled quantification and propagation of uncertainty. Yet in many real-world use cases where these methods are deployed, there is a natural need to preserve the privacy of the individuals whose data is being scrutinized. While a number of works have attempted to approach the problem of差分私人贝叶斯估计differentially private Bayesian estimation通过对后验分布的固有隐私进行推理或将现成的贝叶斯方法私有化，这些作品通常不会在低维设置之外提供严格的效用保证。事实上，即使对于高斯均值估计和线性回归的原型任务，也不知道使用私有算法可以达到贝叶斯最优误差多近，即使在未知参数来自高斯先验的最简单情况下也是如此。through either reasoning about the inherent privacy of the posterior distribution or privatizing off-the-shelf Bayesian methods, these works generally do not come with rigorous utility guarantees beyond low-dimensional settings. In fact, even for the prototypical tasks of Gaussian mean estimation and linear regression, it was unknown how close one could get to the Bayes-optimal error with a private algorithm, even in the simplest case where the unknown parameter comes from a Gaussian prior.

在这项工作中，我们针对这两个问题给出了第一个多项式时间算法，可实现均方误差In this work, we give the first polynomial-time algorithms for both of these problems that achieve mean-squared error(1+o​(1))​OPT(1+o(1))\mathrm{OPT}此外还表明，这两项任务都表现出有趣的计算统计差距。对于贝叶斯均值估计，我们证明我们的方法实现的超额风险在低度框架内的所有有效算法中是最优的，但可证明比指数时间算法可实现的更差。对于线性回归，我们证明了一个定性相似的下界。我们的算法利用了由隐私到鲁棒性的框架and additionally show that both tasks exhibit an intriguing computational-statistical gap. For Bayesian mean estimation, we prove that the excess risk achieved by our method is optimal among all efficient algorithms within the low-degree framework, yet is provably worse than what is achievable by an exponential-time algorithm. For linear regression, we prove a qualitatively similar such lower bound. Our algorithms draw upon the privacy-to-robustness framework introduced by[HKMN23]，但奇怪的是，为了实现私有贝叶斯最优估计，我们需要设计基于平方和的鲁棒估计器, but with the curious twist that to achieve private Bayes-optimal estimation, we need to design sum-of-squares-based robust estimators for本质上不稳健inherently non-robust经验平均值和 OLS 估计器等对象。在此过程中，我们还向平方和工具包添加了一种基于短平坦分解的新型约束。objects like the empirical mean and OLS estimator. Along the way we also add to the sum-of-squares toolkit a new kind of constraint based on short-flat decompositions.

1 简介Introduction

给定数据Given dataxx由一个以未知参数为特征的过程生成的，我们如何更新我们先前的信念？这是贝叶斯推理的目标，并且有丰富的算法和统计工具包可以通过从数据中提取尽可能多的信息来最佳地实现这一目标generated by a process characterized by an unknown parameter , how do we update our prior beliefs about ? This is the goal of Bayesian inference, and there is a rich algorithmic and statistical toolkit for doing so optimally by extracting as much information about as possible from the dataxx。但在许多现实世界的用例中，这个工具包可以并且已经被应用，最佳推理和第二个正交需求之间存在固有的紧张关系：. But in many real-world use cases where this toolkit could be – and is – applied, there is an inherent tension between optimal inference and a second, orthogonal desideratum:隐私privacy。流行病学家通常采用贝叶斯方法来估计大流行的传播速度. Bayesian methods are routinely deployed by epidemiologists to estimate the rate of spread of a pandemic[AHS+25, FMG+20]，由美国人口普查局推断小群体内的统计数据, by the US Census Bureau to infer statistics within small sub-populations[FIH79, CD20]，并由遗传学家预测个体的复杂疾病风险, and by geneticists to predict complex disease risk in individuals[VYF+15]。有没有办法既保留这些技术的统计能力，又保护数据受到审查的个人的隐私？. Is there a way to retain the statistical power of these techniques yet protect the privacy of the individuals whose data is being scrutinized?

同时While差分隐私（DP）differential privacy (DP) [DMNS06a]为研究这个问题提供了理想的形式主义，DP 统计的大部分工作都集中在offers the ideal formalism for studying this question, the bulk of the work on DP statistics has focused on the常客frequentist设置一个人无法访问有关 的先前信息的位置。 Dimitrakakis 等人的早期工作是一个例外。setting where one does not have access to prior information about . An exception to this was the early work of Dimitrakakis et al.[DNZ+17]和王等人。and Wang et al.[WFS15]，他提出了一个诱人的建议。他们假设贝叶斯推理的目标对象，即, who put forth a tantalizing proposal. They posited that the object that Bayesian inference targets, namely the后验分布posterior distribution p(∣x)p(\theta\mid x)，从根本上来说是一个, is fundamentally a概率性的probabilistic对象，因此也许来自该后验的样本具有足够的噪声，可以“免费”进行差分隐私。这是生产线的基础object, so perhaps a sample from this posterior has enough noise to be differentially private “for free.” This was the basis for a productive line of work on后验样本 (OPS) 机制One Posterior Sample (OPS) mechanisms [Zhe15, DNZ+17, WFS15, FGWC16, Mir13, BST14, ZRD16, GSC17]它试图从后验的一些退火版本中输出样本，其基本原理是在对先验和对数似然的（非常强的）假设下which sought to output a sample from some annealed version of the posterior, with the rationale that under (very strong) assumptions on the prior and log-likelihoodslnp(x∣)\ln p(x\mid\theta)，这已经是差分隐私了。, this was already differentially private.

不幸的是，有许多自然设置的真实后验不是私有的，即使对于均值估计和线性回归等规范测试平台也是如此。尽管已经做出了许多努力来通过替代算法来解决这个问题，例如计算足够统计数据的适当噪声Unfortunately, there are many natural settings for which the true posterior is not private, even for canonical testbeds like mean estimation and linear regression. While numerous efforts have been made to remedy this with alternative algorithms like computing a suitable noising of the sufficient statistics[FGWC16, BS18, BS19, FS24]或运行标准贝叶斯方法的 DP 类似物or running DP analogues of standard Bayesian methods[WFS15, FGWC16, HJDH19, ZZ23, Jäl17, HDN+18, PFCW20]，所有这些方法的效用保证要么是未知的，要么仅在低维度上具有定量意义。, the utility guarantees for all of these methods are either unknown or only quantitatively meaningful in low dimensions.

OPS 范式的另一个严重限制是，在贝叶斯推理的典型应用中，具有Another serious limitation of the OPS paradigm is that in typical applications of Bayesian inference, having a单身single后验样本并不是特别有用。如果在更下游的地方，人们想要将后验作为到这一点的不确定性的完整总结，那么人们真正想要的是私下估计sample from the posterior is not particularly useful. If further downstream, one wants to carry forward the posterior as the full summary of one’s uncertainty up to that point, then what one really wants is to privately estimate a描述description后部，或者替代地，of the posterior, or alternatively, a后采样预言机posterior sampling oracle随后可以用来生成that can subsequently be used to generate an任意的arbitrary从后面抽取的次数。例如，如果我们可以私下估计number of draws from the posterior. This would be possible if, for instance, we could privately estimate the足够的统计数据sufficient statistics的数据。of the data.

因此我们要求：We therefore ask:

我们能否严格建立高维度贝叶斯后验采样的隐私与效用权衡？Can we rigorously establish privacy-utility tradeoffs for Bayesian posterior sampling in high dimensions?

在这项工作中，我们对这一基本任务的回答是肯定的。In this work, we answer this in the affirmative for the fundamental tasks of高斯均值估计Gaussian mean estimation和and高斯设计的线性回归linear regression with Gaussian design。与 DP 贝叶斯推理中的现有方法不同，我们利用强大的. In a departure from prior methods in DP Bayesian inference, we leverage the powerful平方和 (SoS) 层次结构sum-of-squares (SoS) hierarchy, 最近被用来为均值估计、回归和相关问题获得最先进的理论保证, which was recently used to obtain state-of-the-art theoretical guarantees for mean estimation, regression, and related problems in the常客frequentist上述任务的 DP 设置DP setting for the aforementioned tasks[CCAd+23, ABMT25, HKMN23]。虽然我们将建立在这些技术的基础上，但正如我们将看到的，贝叶斯设置引入了一系列微妙的现象和技术障碍，而这些现象和技术障碍在频率论设置中不存在。. While we will build upon these techniques, as we will see, the Bayesian setting introduces a host of subtle phenomena and technical hurdles not present in the frequentist setting.

Focusing on the empirical mean is especially counterintuitive as we will ultimately proveTheorem˜1.1通过使用机械by using the machinery of[HKMN23]减少到非常规的to reduce to an unconventional稳健的统计数据robust statistics我们寻求在给定损坏的数据集的情况下估计经验平均值的问题。尽管经验均值是一种著名的非稳健统计量，但对其进行稳健估计对于实现 DP 贝叶斯估计绝对至关重要。我们的鲁棒经验均值估计算法基于对鲁棒参数均值估计的平方和分析的仔细调整，因为problem where we seek to estimate the empirical mean given a corrupted dataset. Whereas the empirical mean is a famously non-robust statistic, robustly estimating it is thus absolutely essential to achieving DP Bayesian estimation. Our algorithm for robust empirical mean estimation is based on a careful adaptation of a sum-of-squares analysis for robust parameter mean estimation due to[KMZ22]。我们将正式定义推迟到. 人们可能想知道是否One might wonder whether the extra term in the计算性的computational率rate inTheorem˜1.1是我们技术的产物。我们设置中的下一个惊喜是它实际上是固有的：DP 贝叶斯均值估计自然地表现出计算统计差距！这也许是出乎意料的，因为问题的表述缺乏稀疏性和低秩结构等间隙的常见特征。is an artifact of our techniques. The next surprise in our setting is that it is actually inherent: DP Bayesian mean estimation naturally exhibits a computational-statistical gap! This is perhaps unexpected given that the problem formulation is absent of the usual signatures for such gaps like sparsity and low-rank structure.

退出各向同性设置是另一个吸引人的特征Stepping back from the isotropic setting, another appealing feature ofTheorem˜1.1是隐私成本体现在is that the privacy cost reflected in统计数据stat和and比较comp不明确依赖于维度（最多对数因子），而是依赖于先验协方差：换句话说，先验告知我们的算法将其隐私预算用于估计的维度。这是 DP 贝叶斯估计相对于 DP 频率估计的关键卖点之一：does not have an explicit dependence on the dimension (up to log factors) and instead depends on the prior covariance : in other words, the prior informs which dimension our algorithm spends its privacy budget focusing on estimating. This is one of the key selling points of DP Bayesian estimation over DP frequentist estimation:先验信息使我们能够通过明智地将不同级别的噪声应用于数据的不同方向来最佳地分配我们的隐私预算prior information allows us to optimally allocate our privacy budget by judiciously applying different levels of noise to different directions of the data。这在数据受限的环境中尤其重要，在这种环境中，简单地添加各向同性噪声来保护隐私可能会削弱实用性。. This is especially crucial in data-constrained settings where simply adding isotropic noise to preserve privacy can cripple utility.

请注意，我们的设置与“协方差感知”均值估计的文献不同Note that our setting differs from the literature on "covariance-aware" mean estimation[BGS+21] [BHS23] [KDH23]在两个方面：首先，在我们的设置中，协方差是已知的in two respects: first, in our setting the covariance is known先验的a priori（字面意义上的）；其次，我们关心(in a literal sense); and second, we care aboutℓ2\ell_{2}而不是马哈拉诺比斯错误。相反，我们的结果具有最接近的参数模拟rather than Mahalanobis error. Rather, our results have the closest parametric analog in[ALNP23]和and[DJY+24]，研究私人均值估计, which study private mean estimation toℓ2\ell_{2}具有已知协方差的各向异性噪声下的范数。norm under anisotropic noise with known covariance.

贝叶斯观点的另一个卖点是它自然地使得Another selling point of the Bayesian perspective is that it naturally enables不确定性的模块化传播modular propagation of uncertainty。贝叶斯统计建立在后验分布的后处理估计的基础上，DP 不受后处理的影响是一个标准事实。在. Bayesian statistics is built upon post-processing estimates of the posterior distribution, and it is a standard fact that DP is immune to post-processing. InSection˜5.5，我们用一个简单的例子来说明这一点，其中我们使用我们的算法来私下估计分布的平均值，该分布的样本是在流设置中逐步提供给我们的。, we illustrate this point with a simple example where we use our algorithm to privately estimate the mean of a distribution whose samples are progressively given to us in a streaming setting.

微分私人贝叶斯估计。Differential private Bayesian estimation.

这里的文献非常广泛，我们参考，例如，The literature here is extensive and we defer to, e.g.,[Sar24, Section 7.2.2]以获得全面的概述。这个方向的结果属于以下一般主题之一：（A）“一个后验样本”方法，从后验或回火中推理单个样本的固有隐私，（B）标准贝叶斯方法的私有实现，以及（C）基于报告噪声充足统计数据的算法。 (A)项下的作品包括for a comprehensive overview. Results in this direction fall under one of the following general themes: (A) “One Posterior Sample” methods that reason about the inherent privacy of a single sample from the posterior or temperings thereof, (B) private implementations of standard Bayesian methods, and (C) algorithms based on reporting noisy sufficient statistics. Works under (A) include[Mir13, DNZ+17, WFS15, GSC17, ZRD16, Zhe15]，其中一个常见的证明策略是论证对数似然, and a common proof strategy therein is to argue that the log-likelihoodlnp(x∣)\ln p(x\mid\theta)利普希茨在is Lipschitz inxx关于数据集距离——在我们的设置中，这样的条件根本不成立。 (B) 项下的工作包括 MCMC 私有化with respect to dataset distance– in our setting, such a condition simply does not hold. 2 技术概述Overview of Techniques

2.1 数据相关统计的隐私性和稳健性Privacy and robustness for data-dependent statistics

我们的第一个概念贡献很简单，但新颖，并且可能广泛适用于稳健和私人统计中的许多不同问题。传统上，我们工作中的论文主要关注参数估计：选择算法未知的参数，生成独立同分布的数据。来自由参数索引的分布，并且算法必须估计给定数据的参数。这是统计学中最常见的设置，因为它封装了基于噪声测量进行猜测的基本统计任务。Our first conceptual contribution is simple, yet novel and perhaps widely applicable to many different problems in robust and private statistics. Traditionally, papers in our line of work have focused on parameter estimation: a parameter is chosen unknown to the algorithm, data is generated i.i.d. from a distribution indexed by the parameter, and the algorithm must estimate the parameter given the data. This is the most common setting in statistics, since it encapsulates the fundamental statistical task of guessing based on noisy measurements.

我们不是估计模型的属性，而是仅仅估计样本的属性。从统计估计的角度来看，这使得这个问题变得微不足道。然而，随着鲁棒性或隐私性的强加，它变得比参数估计设置更加困难：不再能够将分析松弛隐藏在占主导地位的统计术语后面，我们必须单独描述和面对鲁棒性或隐私性的成本。Instead of estimating a property of the model, we look to estimate merely a property of the samples. From a statistical estimation point of view, this makes the problem completely trivial. However, with the imposition of robustness or privacy, it becomes even more difficult than the parameter estimation setting: no longer able to hide analytic slack behind a dominant statistical term, we must characterize and confront the cost of robustness or privacy alone.

我们的主要观察是，为参数估计设置开发的许多技术很容易适应数据估计设置，其中更仔细的分析可以为它们提供更严格的保证。特别是，“鲁棒性意味着隐私”的结果Our main observation is that many of the techniques developed for a parameter-estimation setting are readily adaptable to a data-estimation setting, where more careful analysis gives them tighter guarantees. In particular, the “robustness implies privacy” result of[HKMN23]即使统计数据是数据的属性而不是模型的属性，只要我们的稳健估计器“稳健地”估计未损坏样本的数据相关属性而不是模型的基础参数，该属性仍然成立。我们详细阐述了这一观点still holds even when the statistics are properties of the data rather than of the model, as long as our robust estimators are “robustly” estimating the data-dependent property of the uncorrupted samples rather than of the underlying parameter of the model. We develop this perspective in detail inSection˜5.3.2用于平均估计，以及for mean estimation, andSection˜6.1.2和andSection˜C.4用于线性回归。for linear regression.

2.2 贝叶斯均值估计Bayesian mean estimation

简化为稳健的经验平均值估计。Reduction to robust empirical mean estimation.

在本概述中，我们重点关注各向同性先验情况，因为它包含大量技术直觉。在这种情况下，正如引言中所讨论的，后验均值只是对In this overview we focus on the isotropic prior case as it contains the bulk of the technical intuition. In this setting, as discussed in the introduction, the posterior mean is just a rescaling of the经验平均值empirical mean。为了私下估计这个物体，我们将利用隐私和强大的统计数据之间的强大联系. To privately estimate this object, we will draw upon the powerful connection between privacy and robust statistics developed by[HKM22, HKMN23]。我们精心改造的这台机器. This machinery, which we carefully adapt inSection˜5.3.2根据我们的设置，将问题的本质提炼为稳健统计中的一个相当特殊的问题：给定参数均值未知的高斯数据集的损坏，估计to our setting, distills the essence of our problem to a rather idiosyncratic question in robust statistics: given an -corruption of a Gaussian dataset with unknown parameter mean, estimate the经验平均值empirical mean原始未损坏的数据集。乍一看，这似乎是自相矛盾的，因为经验均值是参数均值的一个非常不稳健的估计量。之所以不存在矛盾，是因为我们感兴趣的是of the original uncorrupted dataset. At first glance this might appear to be paradoxical, as the empirical mean is a horribly non-robust estimator of the parameter mean. The reason there is no contradiction is that we are interested in the empirical mean of the未损坏的uncorrupted数据，通过测量的集中度在任何情况下都接近参数平均值。data, which by concentration of measure is in any case close to the parameter mean.

然而，关键的一点是，我们不想付出这种集中误差的代价，因为它可能与原始贝叶斯估计问题中的贝叶斯最优误差具有相同的数量级！相反，在我们的设置中，我们必须专门针对经验平均值，以获得相对于贝叶斯最优误差而言较低阶的超额风险界限。The crucial point however is that we do not want to pay in this concentration error, as it can be of the same order as the Bayes-optimal error in the original Bayesian estimation problem! Instead, in our setting it is essential that we specifically target the empirical mean in order to obtain excess risk bounds that are of lower order relative to the Bayes-optimal error.

稳健的经验平均值估计算法。Algorithm for robust empirical mean estimation.

3 展望Outlook

在这项工作中，我们迈出了阐明高维私有贝叶斯估计的计算和统计复杂性的第一步。我们在低度框架下开发了高效的算法和匹配的计算难度，首次表明即使在最简单的均值估计和高斯先验线性回归设置中，私人贝叶斯估计也表现出有趣的信息计算差距。我们的工作开辟了许多值得探索的未来方向：In this work we took the first steps towards elucidating the computational and statistical complexity of private Bayesian estimation in high dimensions. We developed efficient algorithms and matching computational hardness under the low-degree framework, showing for the first time that private Bayesian estimation exhibits an intriguing information-computation gap even in the simplest settings of mean estimation and linear regression with Gaussian prior. Our work opens up a wealth of future directions to explore:

超越高斯先验。Beyond Gaussian prior.

关于一般先验的高维贝叶斯推理的算法和计算统计差距有丰富的文献（例如，参见There is a rich literature on algorithms and computational-statistical gaps for Bayesian inference in high dimensions for general priors (see, e.g.,[ZK16, KZ24, MS+24]用于概述）。绘制出何时可以进行有效计算的估计与何时可以进行任何重要估计的相图，利用了源自统计物理学的复杂思想工具箱，并且描述当施加隐私或鲁棒性约束时相图如何变化是未来研究的一个有趣方向。for overviews). Mapping out the phase diagram of when computationally efficient estimation is possible vs. any nontrivial estimation is possible draws upon a sophisticated toolbox of ideas originating from statistical physics, and characterizing how the phase diagram changes when one imposes privacy or robustness constraints is a fascinating direction for future study.

相关地，虽然在像高斯这样的简单指数族先验的情况下，后验采样立即来自后验均值估计，但通常情况并非如此。对于其他先验，可以开发私有的还是鲁棒的Relatedly, whereas in the case of simple exponential family priors like Gaussian, posterior sampling follows immediately from posterior mean estimation, this is not the case in general. For other priors, can one develop private or robust后采样posterior sampling在这些更具挑战性的环境中使用算法？algorithms in these more challenging settings?

其他推理任务。Other inference tasks.

还有大量其他自然贝叶斯问题可以本着我们的工作精神进行研究，例如线性二次估计、社区检测、矩阵和张量估计、组测试等。如中讨论的There is a wealth of other natural Bayesian problems that could be studied in the spirit of our work, e.g. linear quadratic estimation, community detection, matrix and tensor estimation, group testing, etc. As discussed inSection˜1.1，已经有一些关于其中一些任务的稳健性的工作，尽管其中的保证似乎尚未适用于获得隐私保证。即使对于均值估计和线性回归，这项工作中也出现了有趣的现象学和技术微妙之处，这表明对于这些其他任务还有许多更有趣的见解有待发现。, there have already been some works on robustness for some of these tasks, although the guarantees therein do not appear to be applicable yet to obtaining privacy guarantees. The intriguing phenomenology and technical subtleties surfaced in this work even for mean estimation and linear regression suggest that there are many more interesting insights to be uncovered for these other tasks.

近似DPApproximate DP

虽然我们的两个稳健估计器都会产生近似 DP 估计器While both of our robust estimators would yield approx-DP estimators by[HKMN23]，这些近似 DP 估计器和最优统计率之间存在相同的精度差距。然而，如何证明高效近似 DP 估计器的匹配计算下界变得不太清楚，因为隐私到鲁棒性的降低, the same accuracy gap exists between these approx-DP estimators and the optimal statistical rate. However, it becomes much less clear how to prove a matching computational lower bound for the efficient approx-DP estimator, since the privacy-to-robustness reduction of[GH22]不再适用。自然的后续步骤是严格描述近似DP下贝叶斯估计的计算成本以及隐私的替代概念。no longer applies. A natural follow-up step would be to tightly characterize the computational cost of Bayes estimation under approx-DP, as well as alternative notions of privacy.

严格的计算下限。Tight computational lower bound.

4.3 平方和背景Sum-of-squares background

在本文中，我们使用平方和（SoS）半定规划层次结构In this paper, we use the sum-of-squares (SoS) semidefinite programming hierarchy[BS14, RSS18]用于算法设计和分析。 平方和证明到算法框架已被证明在算法统计中的许多最佳或最先进的结果中非常有用。 我们在此简要介绍伪分布、平方和证明和平方和算法。for both algorithm design and analysis. The sum-of-squares proofs-to-algorithms framework has been proven useful in many optimal or state-of-the-art results in algorithmic statistics. We provide here a brief introduction to pseudo-distributions, sum-of-squares proofs, and sum-of-squares algorithms.

对于仅近似满足多项式系统的伪分布，我们仍然可以使用平方和证明来推理它，就像For a pseudo-distribution that only approximately satisfies a polynomial system, we can still use sum-of-squares proofs to reason about it in the same way asSection˜4.3.1。 为了使近似误差在整个推理过程中不被放大，我们需要确保平方和证明中系数的位复杂度是多项式有界的。. In order for approximation errors not to amplify throughout reasoning, we need to ensure that the bit complexity of the coefficients in the sum-of-squares proof are polynomially bounded.

我们可能希望有一种计算效率高的平方和算法，甚至可以匹配统计上的最佳速率We might hope for a computationally efficient sum-of-squares algorithm that even matches the statistically optimal rate ofTheorem˜5.5用于稳健的经验均值估计，以便我们可以有效地应用减少for robust empirical mean estimation, so that we can efficiently apply the reduction of[HKMN23]以获得私人经验平均值估计的统计最优率。在本节中，我们将证明这是不可能的。我们将首先使用低度框架展示鲁棒问题的计算下界，然后通过中提出的隐私到鲁棒性减少来展示隐私问题的计算下界。to attain a statistically optimal rate for private empirical mean estimation. In this section, we will prove that this is not possible. We will first show a computational lower bound for the robust problem using the low-degree framework, and then a computational lower bound for the private problem via the privacy-to-robustness reduction proposed in[GH22].

C.2 证明Proof ofTheorem˜6.2：稳健且私有的贝叶斯回归的低效算法: Inefficient algorithm for robust and private Bayesian regression

在本节中，我们首先给出贝叶斯回归的低效鲁棒算法。 为简单起见，我们的算法基于之前稳健且高效的线性回归估计器。 与经验均值估计一样，我们可以利用更好的弹性界限来稳健地逼近后验均值估计器（或等效的岭回归估计器）。 最后我们使用黑盒鲁棒性来减少隐私In this section, we first give an inefficient robust algorithm for Bayesian regression. For simplicity, we base our algorithm on our previous robust and efficient linear regression estimator. As in empirical mean estimation, we can exploit better resilience bound for approximating the posterior mean estimator(or equivalently ridge regression estimator) robustly. Finally we use the black-box robustness to privacy reduction[HKMN23, AUZ23]用于开发具有最佳错误保证的差分隐私算法。for developing a differentially private algorithm with optimal error guarantees.
